reason: The zod override lifts every copy to ^4.6.6 except @google/design.md's, so the only vulnerable copy left is the zod v3 that this dev-only linter requires. The store-worker's production zod resolves to 4.6.7, which is why npm audit --omit=dev reports node-forge alone.

Dev-only linter at its latest published version (0.4.0); it declares zod ^3.24.0, so the legacy major cannot be lifted without breaking it. The override block scopes this exception by name rather than leaving all of zod at v3.
